manualReview.explanation: The NIST draft asks how uncertain per-hop delay, dynamic channels, missing instrumentation and software-stack overhead affect 5G-TSN validation. The closest ITU draft concerns submarine-cable failures and repair procedures; the next ONS, ETSI and FCC drafts concern different measurements, standards parameters or denominators. Shared 5G or cross-page wording alone does not establish an answer overlap.
manualReview.sourceFamily: NIST TN 2363 is a separate publication family from the inspected ITU, FCC, ETSI, ONS, European Commission and IEEE candidate originals. This bounded screen does not rule out uncatalogued derivative sources or unrecorded development exposure.
